name: project-wiki
description: Karpathy-style LLM Wiki applied across all Claude Code and Cowork projects. Imposes a canonical project layout (raw/ + output/ + wiki/ + code/wiki/), maintains an Obsidian-compatible knowledge base, takes over existing project conventions cleanly, and snapshots the wiki into code/wiki/ on /go-to-code. Three policies are baked in at the plugin level (not per-project): default-to-output (Claude writes drafts to output/), curate-to-wiki (wiki/ entries go through a mandatory wiki-curator gate), and keep-it-lean (wiki-pruner compacts verbose investigation pages once issues are resolved, archiving detail to output/<date>-resolved-<issue>/). Fifteen layered skills inheriting from skill-architect's foundation abstracts.
